name: IndoNLG
description: IndoNLG is the first benchmark to measure natural language generation progress in three low-resource Indonesian languages: Indonesian, Javanese, and Sundanese. It covers six tasks including summarization, question answering, chit-chat, and three machine translation pairs, aiming to facilitate NLG system development for these widely spoken but low-resource languages.
reputation: A well-known early benchmark for low-resource Indonesian NLG that has been widely cited in Indonesian NLP research.
notes: Focuses on low-resource Indonesian languages and includes a clean pretraining corpus Indo4B-Plus.
